newsitem.title: UK: Bell Cablemedia has 99.2 pct of Videotron.
newsitem.headline: Bell Cablemedia has 99.2 pct of Videotron.

text.p: Britain's Bell Cablemedia Plc said on Friday it had about 99.2 percent of Videotron Holdings' shares and would keep its offer for the company open until February 21.

The initial period for the company's offer of $3.95 for each Videotron ordinary share and $19.75 per American Depositary share expired on Thursday. At the time of expiry, Bell Cablemedia had validly tendered ordinary shares and ADSs representing about 17.5 percent of Videotron's share capital, the company said in a statement.
The shares, together with stock already owned by Bell Cablemedia prior to the offer, represented about 99.2 percent of Videotron's ordinary share capital.
The firm's acquisition of Videotron formed part of the planned merger of the two cable companies with Cable and Wireless Plc's Mercury unit in Britain and NYNEX CableComms Group, part of NYNEX Corp.
